rule: the abstain temperature is fitted on the TRAINING cohorts' held-out slides only
note: Fitting it on ferguson would calibrate the abstain rule on the test set. The whole stage would be worthless and it would not look worthless.

rule: report BOTH temperature-scaled max softmax and distance to the nearest prototype
note: msp is the standard baseline. proto is the score files/05 section 4.11 named, and the only one that works on a cohort with NO labels, because it never reads the answer. Reporting only the winner would hide which kind of signal is doing the work.

rule: an accuracy-versus-coverage curve, no recommended operating point
note: The design asked for a curve. The right threshold depends on what the annotation is for, and picking one here would be inventing a use case.

rule: macro-F1 is reported at every coverage level, next to accuracy
note: Accuracy rises trivially when abstention discards the rare classes. If accuracy climbs while macro-F1 does not, the rule is buying its gain by throwing away exactly the four cell types Stage 7a showed are the hard ones. Without this column that looks like success.

rule: the novel-class test uses ferguson EP - the label no cluster admitted in space B2 - instead of the design's cohort-exclusive clusters
note: files/05 section 4.11 specified cohort-exclusive clusters, which needs a retrain per held-out cluster. Stage 7a produced something better for free: in B2 the frozen partition admitted NO cluster for EP (average distance 0.8120 against a cut of 0.800), so it is a genuinely novel type on a genuinely unseen cohort that the model was never told exists. 5,488 cells in the scored table. Declared as a substitution rather than presented as the original test.

rule: AUROC for detecting the novel type, both scores
note: No threshold declared because there is no prior worth committing to. Stated in advance so it cannot be reframed afterwards: an AUROC near 0.5 means the model cannot tell it is looking at something new, and that is a REPORTABLE FAILURE of the deliverable, not a null result to be dropped. It would mean the system cannot be trusted to flag a new cell type on arrival - the exact situation a new cohort presents.

rule: calibration and novelty reported for A, B1 and B2
note: D-51 measured that a three-cluster granularity difference moves macro-F1 by 0.09 even between spaces agreeing at ARI 0.9828. One space is not enough to characterise anything here.

rule: the report states that every curve rests on one fitted model and one seed
note: H9 applies to these curves exactly as it applies to every other number in this project. Saying so is not optional.
